summary: This Form 8-K items 7.01 and 8.01 filing by Kalaris Therapeutics, Inc. announces positive additional data from its Phase 1a clinical trial of TH103 for nAMD. No corporate transaction or special situation is disclosed—only a clinical update and an investor presentation. The company issues the press release and presentation as the filer. There are no deal terms, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no structural changes. This is a routine disclosure of material non-public information under Regulation FD and Other Events. For risk-arb or special-situation investors, this filing contains no actionable event and is purely a clinical update.
